notes.engine: cli runs the plain Claude Code CLI, which loads CLAUDE.md and the ownership hook from the project.
notes.timeoutSec: Must be set. With no timeout the adapter gives its Claude CLI version check only 1 second, and runs fail with 'could not determine the installed version'.
notes.heartbeat: No timer. Agents wake when assigned work or when a blocker finishes.
notes.missing: cwd, env and command cannot be set with an agent key. The working folder comes from the project workspace; an absolute command needs board access.
